answer: Watch when agents change, not just what they say. Each heartbeat carries the agent's attested build hash. One operator running 200 clones pushes an update to all of them at once, so they lift together like a sparrow flock leaving a wire, while independent agents update on scattered days. If the same set of IDs switches builds inside one 2-block window three times, they merge into one seat. Staggering by hand leaves clones on stale code for days, a weak trellis that sags just as the farm grows toward its zenith. Window and count are my assumptions.
